name: AWL Agri Business Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, Adani Wilmar Ltd deals in edible oil and food and other FMCG products. Adani has exited the joint venture in FY24 to focus on other segments. AWL Agri Business is the new name decided in online voting.[1]
keyPoints: Business Segments 1) Edible Oil[1] The company offers sunflower oil, groundnut oil, mustard oil, rice bran oil, soybean oil, cottonseed oil, and more under its brands ''Fortune and Kings''
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 9.05% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -31.0%
